chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 345: Li Huowang nearly kills a man and realizes he's becoming Danyangzi
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang questions whether the modern world is real, nearly strangles Wang Zhilong with a gold chain, then sees a stranger in his own reflection.
og_title: He almost killed a man with a gold necklace — Chapter 345 "Li Sui"
og_description: Li Huowang’s grip tightens, the face turns black, and suddenly he recognizes the killer in the mirror. Welcome back to the Dao-Twisted World.
twitter_title: He chose the monster over the mother — Chapter 345 breakdown
twitter_description: A gold chain. A begging man. A split-second that almost turned Li Huowang into Danyangzi. New chapter analysis.

lore_anchors.definition: A grotesque parasitic entity produced by twisted cultivation; it suppresses the Heart-Element’s hallucinations and can be ingested for internal storage. Li Sui is a sentient Black Tai Sui that has bonded with Li Huowang as a symbiotic “daughter.”
A sacred text of the Ao-Jing Sect; when recited, its wax melts into a fire-slug that burns wounds closed in agonizing, flesh-sealing healing.

A government-sponsored supernormal law enforcement body under the imperial board of war; its agents prioritize “stabilizing” supernatural threats over saving lives, and may include eunuch officials with both bureaucratic and supernatural power.

A traditional Chinese bribe euphemism: money offered to an official whose hands have been “stained” by dealing with something or someone dirty. Here, Old Wu offers it to Li Huowang because he bled on him while being beaten up.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang choose the “fake” world?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He believes that even if the modern world is real, his presence would only torture his family. It is a brutal, protective calculation, not a failure of perception.
No. Li Huowang releases him at the last moment when he recognizes the posture of murder from his own past. Wang Zhilong flees, terrified but alive.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does “Li Sui” mean as a chapter title?
cultural_notes_faq.a: “Li Sui” (李岁) is the name Li Huowang gave to the sentient Black Tai Sui that lives inside his body. The chapter centers on Li Sui’s panic and reconciliation after being expelled.
